notes.title: STEAM DECK work around
notes.content:
Hey gamers!

If you're reading this, you probably got one of them Steam Decks I've been hearing so much about.

SLIPPY didn't run on the Steam Deck when I launched it earlier this year, which sucked at the time.
Basically, it's the CRT TV shader that is causing SLIPPY to crash on the Steam Deck, and I don't understand shaders enough that I've been able to fix this issue.

However, I have done this work around that flat out disables the shaders that crash the steam deck version. I'm aware it's not the ideal solution, but at least now you can play on the go if you'd like to.
Please read below carefully, and if you have any issues shoot me a message.

[u]HOW TO DO THE WORK AROUND[/u]
Tap (B) button when the game is opening (the very first 2 second loading screen). 
A popup will appear, telling you that the shaders are deactivated.
[b][i]You have to do this each time the game boots.[/i][/b]

[u]WARNING[/u]
The game looks different with this change! I designed the game with the shaders active the whole time, so things don't look the same without them, and some levels vibe's will be altered without the shaders on.

Thanks everyone! The release this year was a dream so I can't thank you all enough.
